# Glaze: Icon Themes & Widgets

> Glaze gives your iPhone a Home Screen that fits together: over 250 original themes, each with a wallpaper, matching app icons and five artworks for your widgets. Free download with 10 premium themes free to keep. Glaze Plus unlocks every theme for A$2.99 a year (the App Store shows your local price). No ads, no weekly plan.
